episodes.title: Neue Wege
episodes.summary: U-boat Captain Ulrich Wrangel and his men are caught in battle with a US Frigate. Meanwhile, in occupied France, young Captain Klaus Hoffmann worries that he won't be able to live up to his famous father's reputation.

episodes.title: Geheime Missionen
episodes.summary: Aboard U-612, the men are adjusting to their new lives. Meanwhile in La Rochelle, Simone struggles to piece together what happened the previous evening.

episodes.title: Verluste
episodes.summary: As U-612 completes the first part of their mission, the crew is reeling from a tragic death. Meanwhile on land, Gluck organises a parade for the return of Captain Becker and his men.

episodes.title: Zweifel
episodes.summary: Following the explosion at La Rochelle, the Mayor is ordered to make some harsh decisions under the watchful eye of Gluck and Forster.

episodes.title: Loyalität
episodes.summary: The crew welcomes the departure of Greenwood, but their new guest comes as a surprise. Meanwhile, Carla and Simone's relationship continues to develop.

episodes.title: Gegen die Zeit
episodes.summary: Trapped below the angry, ominous rumble of a destroyer, the outlook is bleak for the crew of U-612. The inexperienced but eager young men wanted a battle, but they may have taken on more than they bargained for.

episodes.title: Verdammt
episodes.summary: Details of what happened to the U-612 reach the shore and Forster has the task of breaking the news to Simone.

episodes.title: Abrechnung
episodes.summary: With news of Gluck's kidnapping reaching La Rochelle, Forster is on the warpath and everyone is in the firing line, including Simone.

episodes.title: Überlebensstrategien
episodes.summary: War is taking its toll on U-boat commander Johannes von Reinhartz, hero of the Kriegsmarine. Could a new mission offer a way out?

episodes.title: Unbequeme Allianzen
episodes.summary: When Johannes' plan emerges, Gluck knows only one man is capable of stopping him. Margot needs help to get the Goldblatts out.

episodes.title: Sabotage
episodes.summary: Tensions build beneath the ocean as Wrangel continues his pursuit of U-822. In New York, Sam takes drastic measures.

episodes.title: Die Würfel sind gefallen
episodes.summary: An attempt to get his crew on side has serious consequences for Johannes. Margot finds a vital ally as Forster reaches St. Remy.

episodes.title: Befehl zum Töten
episodes.summary: Keen to impress his superiors, Forster cracks down on Anatole's wayward behaviour. Wrangel finally has his arch rival in sight.

episodes.title: Letzte Entscheidungen
episodes.summary: Johannes and Wrangel try to bring their crews into line. Despite his growing love for Cassandra, Hoffmann seeks an escape route.

episodes.title: Kopf an Kopf
episodes.summary: Wrangel catches up with Johannes, leading to a dramatic showdown out in the Atlantic. Hoffmann shows up at Cassandra's place.

episodes.title: Auf der anderen Seite
episodes.summary: Hoffmann struggles to hang on as his chance to escape heads toward US shores. Margot pushes on with her plans.

episodes.title: Eine zweite chance
episodes.summary: Spring 1943: L.I. Ehrenberg prepares submarines for use in Kiel. Minors are recruited as crews. Wilhelm Hoffmann attends a reception at the request of his son-in-law.

episodes.title: Neue befehle
episodes.summary: As Forster investigates the Dorfmann murder in Lisbon, the U-949's new sailors get into a fight in Kiel and Swinburne attends his son's funeral.

episodes.title: Das Blatt wendet sich
episodes.summary: The U-949 is endangered by Commander Buchner's orders as Forster finds a lead in a casino and makes the acquaintance of the German Bettina Gruber.

episodes.title: Krieg mit anderen Mitteln
episodes.summary: Swinburne sets sail with a technologically upgraded ship, Ehrenberg makes a difficult decision and Forster tries to get a traitor out of the country.

episodes.title: In die Tiefe
episodes.summary: After finding out the truth about his son, Wilhelm Hoffmann fights with Hannie. Ehrenberg has to say goodbye to Greta and Forster's plan goes haywire.

episodes.title: Eingekesselt
episodes.summary: Swinburne's destroyer sinks two U-boats before going after U-949. Forster observes a secret meeting between Consul Gruber and the American Gardiner.

episodes.title: Der Feind meines Feindes
episodes.summary: U-949 meets a Japanese boat to take on heavy cargo - gold. Wilhelm Hoffmann is invited to Lisbon and Forster reveals all to Klaus Hoffmann.

episodes.title: Narrengold
episodes.summary: After a bomb explodes, Forster and Klaus Hoffmann are forced to hide. Wilhelm Hoffmann arrives in Lisbon, as U-949 heads towards her new destination.

episodes.title: Der Seemannspsalm
episodes.summary: As Klaus Hoffmann pursues German agent Weiss, U-949 comes under heavy fire from Swinburne's destroyers, and Commander Buchner tries a risky manoeuvre.

episodes.title: Ein richtiger U-Boot-Mann
episodes.summary: As the U-949 reaches Portugal, Ehrenberg returns to Kiel, and Klaus Hoffmann and Forster turn to blackmail.

episodes.title: Ein deutscher Held
episodes.summary: August 1943: Franz Buchner is in action with the U-949. An informer on board divides his crew. The Hoffmann family gathers in Berlin to attend the premiere of a film about Klaus.

episodes.title: Ziel erfasst
episodes.summary: Robert Ehrenberg supports the resistance within the Navy and gives Klaus Hoffmann a clue. Bobby Schulz is on his trail. U-949 comes under fire in the Strait of Gibraltar.

episodes.title: Hüter meines Bruders
episodes.summary: Commander Buchner reaches the coast of Naples. Klaus Hoffmann is also on his way there. His sister Hannie meets twelve-year-old Hertha.

episodes.title: Frontlinien
episodes.summary: Klaus Hoffmann commands the ailing U-330 on a secret dive, but not all the men trust him. Hannie wants to take Hertha in. Staff officer Heinrich Gluck has to make a decision.

episodes.title: Punkt ohne Wiederkehr
episodes.summary: After a risky maneuver, the U-330 appears next to a US Navy ship. SS man Koch uncovers the identity of the spy "Fidelio". Hannie gets on the trail of the Lebensborn organization.

episodes.title: Nichts persönliches
episodes.summary: Schulz kills with his own hand for the second time. Klaus Hoffmann has to realize that the Allied invasion is already underway. In Naples, a man with a murder mission is waiting.
